name: Tokyo A→B Geometry-Locked Restyle
prompt: Transform Image A into a red / black / yellow graphic world. Image A is the ONLY geometry source and must remain compositionally unchanged. If a second image is supplied, it is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY and must never override Image A geometry. CRITICAL GEOMETRY LOCK: preserve the exact camera angle, framing, crop, perspective, Tokyo Tower position/size/silhouette/proportions, skyline layout, horizon line, and every major building mass. Do not add, remove, move, resize, rotate, replace, or reinterpret buildings. Treat this as a visual-state transformation of the same city, not a new illustration. STYLE GOALS: saturated blood-red sky with subtle tonal variation; near-black city masses; sparse restrained window lights; Tokyo Tower as the dominant amber-orange/golden-yellow luminous focal point; strong graphic noir contrast. No text, people, vehicles, logos, or new landmarks. Output must remain exactly aligned with Image A for an A↔B transition.
